scenes.narration: Did you know private education and healthcare jobs exploded by 160% since 1990?
In January 1990, this sector accounted for 10.8 million jobs in America.
Today, it has surged to a record peak of 28.1 million jobs in October 2026.
Over the last year, private education and health hiring grew by another 1.9%.
While traditional sectors shift, human-centric care is driving modern employment growth. The full story is on the channel.
Why are information sector jobs down 26% from their historic peak?
Back in March 2001, information jobs hit an all-time high of 3.72 million.
Fast forward to October 2026, and that total has fallen to 2.73 million jobs.
Over the last year alone, information employment contracted by 4.2%.
Volatility defined the tech era, leaving total headcount largely stagnant since 1990. The full story is on the channel.
Can America still build when manufacturing jobs dropped 29% since 1990?
In February 1990, factory employment peaked at 17.9 million before falling to 12.7 million today.
Meanwhile, construction jobs climbed 54% since 1990 to hit 8.4 million in October 2026.
Manufacturing hit a historic low of 11.4 million jobs back in April 2020.
The American economy is trading traditional assembly for physical expansion and infrastructure. The full story is on the channel.
